steps.title: new, in three lines
steps.text: `forgeNew(Test, 'saber', 12)` creates an object whose prototype is `Test.prototype`, runs `Test` with it as `this`, and returns it. The constructor printed `new init list:  saber 12`, and `foobar`, found on the prototype, printed `12`.
steps.textZh: `forgeNew(Test, 'saber', 12)` 先创建一个原型为 `Test.prototype` 的对象，再以它为 `this` 运行 `Test`，最后把它返回。构造函数打印了 `new init list:  saber 12`，在原型上找到的 `foobar` 打印了 `12`。

watch.label: test has its own foobar
watch.labelZh: test 自身有 foobar 吗

steps.title: Returning an object replaces it
steps.text: If the constructor returns an object, `new` gives you that object instead. `forgeNew` does the same as the built-in `new`.
steps.textZh: 如果构造函数返回一个对象，`new` 给你的就是那个对象。`forgeNew` 和内置的 `new` 行为一致。

action.run: function Box() { this.kept = true; return { replaced: true }; } console.log('forgeNew:', JSON.stringify(forgeNew(Box)), '| new:', JSON.stringify(new Box()))

steps.actionLabel: Try a constructor that returns an object
steps.actionLabelZh: 试一个返回对象的构造函数

steps.title: Returning null does not
steps.text: `null` and primitives such as `5` do not replace the new object.
steps.textZh: 返回 `null` 或 `5` 这样的原始值，不会替换新创建的对象。

action.run: function Nil() { this.kept = true; return null; } console.log('forgeNew:', JSON.stringify(forgeNew(Nil)), '| new:', JSON.stringify(new Nil()))

steps.actionLabel: Try a constructor that returns null
steps.actionLabelZh: 试一个返回 null 的构造函数

steps.title: A class is not an ordinary constructor
steps.titleZh: class 不是普通的构造函数
steps.text: A class constructor cannot run without `new`, and `forgeNew` calls it with `apply`, so it throws a `TypeError`. The README lists this among the limits.
steps.textZh: class 的构造函数不能不加 `new` 就运行，而 `forgeNew` 是用 `apply` 调用的，所以会抛出 `TypeError`。README 把这一点列在了局限里。

action.run: try { forgeNew(class Point {}) } catch (error) { console.log('forgeNew(class) threw a', error.name) }
